name: Secrets of Perfect Life
author: BerkerGames
description:
Find the secret combination of the perfect life. Collect Money, Love, Health, and Knowledge. 
Try all different combinations to see the different results. (There are 26 different endings.)

Move with "WASD" or "Arrow Keys". Make any combination you wish by collecting or ignoring items
then move into the green light and see the results. In order to open doors you must collect the requirements.

Externally acquired assets:
SFX's:  freesound.org
Music:  ecrettmusic.com

This game was made for Create With Code Jam 2020.

Game Arts by Gizem Uçar
Programming by Berker Uçar
